review_description: The sales person was "on the ball" came to visit our site looked at our power usage and quoted a 22kW system.We installed the 22kW three phase system at our company and the experience was first rate all the way.We got what we were quoted for and all install dates and commissioning dates were met.The installation team were great to watch working a real team effort and no drama's just really good all round.It is now producing 19.9kw since it was commissioned.Very happy with the whole installation.

The sales person oversold what the system was capable of.System was not compliant (incorrect electrial conduit used, panel fixings not compliant)General manager is extremely arrogant and had not even bothered to come out to look at the issues,  I ended up going through NCAT to get any action from the company.By far the worst company I have dealt with and would not use for any type of work.ABSOLUTELY NO PROFESSIONALISM
Bought a warranted 10kW system about one year ago, not working well, asked for service, still no show up, now complaint to Consumer Affair.
Information about solar power cells, inverters etc can be confusing.I always referred back to your website for back up informationThanks
